confirmedBaselineDifferences.evidence: Pi estimateTokens uses per-content chars/4 plus a fixed image heuristic. PiSharp PiContextUsageEstimator matches that explicit content heuristic for durable context estimates. The separate AutoCompactionPolicy.Estimate serializes transient request messages and uses chars/2 plus 64 per message plus 512; a source-linked regression proves this is more conservative than the Pi-compatible message estimate. It is used only to bound an ephemeral provider projection, which preserves canonical history. Neither estimate is tokenizer output.

At pinned Pi b06c1f2, AgentSession._checkCompaction passes contextWindow 0 to shouldCompact and can trigger compaction; PiSharp preserves the unknown limit. C2, C4, and C5 classify this behavior as an intentional safety difference, with the UnknownContextWindowDoesNotInventCapacityFromReportedUsage regression. The upstream queue-test expectation remains inconsistent with the pinned formula, but the observed difference is no longer unresolved.

At pinned Pi b06c1f2, real AgentSession tool continuations send the full large tool result and the provider hook accepts seeded incomplete or duplicate call/result history. At PiSharp source 1ff1d67, the in-flight projector keeps raw canonical messages unchanged, bounds the large result in its transient request, and rejects malformed groups before the projected continuation send. Sequential, parallel, nested and steering observations pass their normalized assertions.

architectureConstraints: MAF owns agent execution and tool invocation
Runtime owns planning/coordination/usage; Sessions own durable history and recovery; CLI owns provider mappings and projections
Persistent canonical compaction and transient outbound context projection are separate behaviors.
implementationChanges: Branch summary navigation with extension control, summary settings, file-operation details, usage/cost persistence and editor-return behavior.
Missing-total usage fallback includes cached-read and cached-write counts.
Successful post-turn provider usage above a known context window emits overflow compaction without replay; cached input is not double-counted.
Expanded provider error overflow patterns and representative exclusions with regressions.

Recoverable length-stop response handling checks reported output tokens against the desired model output cap, request model identity, and current context projection; it omits the failed response from outbound context, compacts once, and continues once.
The C5 Pi/PiSharp deterministic oracle records provider requests, session state and events twice per implementation and binds two case results to distinct hashed artifacts.

A paired C6 adapter drives pinned Pi AgentSession tool loops and PiSharp InFlightContextBudget, including sequential, parallel, nested, oversized, steering and malformed tool histories. It verifies raw canonical-history preservation and records four case-scoped safety differences.

C7 paired summary-generation behavior: prompt serialization, prior summaries, split-turn focus, tool/file details, reserve-aware output caps, length-stop failure, transient retry policy, usage and routed reasoning; reject whitespace-only summaries.
C8 compaction usage persistence: aggregate summary usage is retained on compaction entries for Pi JSONL export/import while native per-request billing entries remain authoritative.

C8 persistence and provider-after-reload coverage: compaction usage/metadata round-trip, canonical history recovery, branch/fork/clone restoration, restart continuation, and live SDK request comparison for Responses, Chat Completions, and Anthropic.
C9 branch navigation: branch-summary prompts now match Pi, including custom summarization instructions; the summary preamble and navigation result are covered by paired pinned observations.

C10 usage accounting preserves unknown provider counts and costs, separates uncached input from cached reads, carries cache writes and reasoning tokens, and projects canonical totals across compaction, active branch, CLI, TUI, and RPC surfaces.

C11 integration: RPC compaction cost components remain unknown when provider usage omits them; JSON compaction lifecycle events expose Pi-shaped reason/result/aborted/willRetry payloads. The paired C11 adapter and case evidence pass within C1-C13 135/135 at final implementation source 41e9b7e7ebdea70b878e409204cd8b3d177144e2.
